headlines.title: SpaceX hit by surging AI costs as insiders prepare to sell their shares
headlines.description: Capital expenditures related to its xAI unit, which runs the Grok service, hit $15.8 billion, more than double what they were in the first quarter.

headlines.title: Judge denies request by Elon Musk’s xAI to pause Minnesota nudification ban
headlines.description: A judge denied a request from Elon Musk’s AI company xAI to block Minnesota’s law that will be the first in the nation to ban nudification technology.

headlines.title: Abdul El-Sayed Wins High-Stakes Democratic Primary in Michigan
headlines.description: In the closely-watched Democratic senate primary in Michigan, voters chose Abdul El-Sayed as their party’s nominee, defeating establishment-backed Congresswoman Haley Stevens. El-Sayed will now face a bruising battle against Republican nominee, former Congressman Mike Rogers, who was endorsed by Trump, for an open seat. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports and Meet the Press moderator Kristen Welker joins TODAY with analysis on the key primary results ahead of the November midterm elections.

headlines.title: Progressive William Lawrence wins Democratic primary in one of the country’s biggest House races
headlines.description: Sunrise Movement co-founder William Lawrence is the Democratic nominee in Michigan’s 7th District, NBC News projects, a key battleground in the fight for the House majority.

headlines.title: Trump-backed John James wins Michigan’s GOP primary for governor
headlines.description: Rep. John James has won Michigan’s Republican nomination for governor, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: U.S. bans many new foreign made robots
headlines.description: The FCC won’t allow many new foreign made robotic devices, a lot of them coming from China, to be sold in the U.S., citing national security and economic concerns. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: White House hosts meeting with top AI companies
headlines.description: The White House hosted a meeting with representatives from top AI companies, including Anthropic, Meta and OpenAI. President Trump did not attend the meeting which was focused on voluntary AI safety testing for advanced AI models.

headlines.title: Ukraine's robotic amphibious landing signals global arms race of autonomous weapons
headlines.description: From robotic beach landings to AI-powered "Terminator" drones, what was once the realm of sci-fi is now becoming reality on the battlefield in Ukraine. The pioneering of autonomous weapons is sparking a global arms race with the U.S., Russia and China racing to keep up. NBC News' Matt Bradley reports.

headlines.title: Urgent warning over water system cyberattacks
headlines.description: The Trump administration is warning about potential cyberattacks after a senior law enforcement official told NBC News that a cyberattack on water systems in Minnesota had all the hallmarks of Iranian-backed hackers. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: How ‘cigfluencers’ are bringing back smoking on social media against doctors’ orders
headlines.description: Despite medical research, some content creators say cigarettes are back in fashion. "Cigfluencers" are making waves online as Hollywood and magazines seem to embrace the old habit. NBC News' Dr. Akshay Syal reports.

headlines.title: OpenAI's rogue AI hacking of several companies opens new cybersecurity questions
headlines.description: OpenAI revealed that its AI agent tried to hack several other companies after hacking into Hugging Face. Juan Andrés Guerrero-Saade, Sentinelone's VP of intelligence and security research, joins NBC News' Garrett Haake to discuss whether Congress can regulate the pace of AI growth and the future of cybersecurity amid AI hackers.

headlines.title: FCC chair defends new U.S. ban on foreign-made humanoid robots, a market China dominates
headlines.description: The Trump administration will ban foreign-made humanoid robots in the U.S. as China seeks to dominate the emerging high-tech market. Speaking to NBC News, the FCC chair Brendan Carr defends the move. NBC News' Kelly O'Donnell reports.
